sn55.40:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
sn55.40:1.2: atha kho nandiyo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho nandiyo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn55.40:1.3: “yasseva nu kho bhante, ariyasāvakassa cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ natthi, so eva nu kho bhante, ariyasāvako pamādavihārī”ti?
sn55.40:2.1: yassa kho nandiya, cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ natthi, tamahaṃ bāhiro puthujjanapakkhe ṭhitoti vadāmi.
sn55.40:2.2: api ca nandiya, yathā ariyasāvako pamādavihārī ceva hoti appamādavihārī ca.
sn55.40:3.2: idha nandiya, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.40:3.3: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.40:3.4: so tena buddhe aveccappasādena santuṭṭho na uttariṃ vāyamati divā pavivekāya rattiṃ paṭisallānāya.
sn55.40:3.5: tassa evaṃ pamattassa viharato pāmujjaṃ na hoti.
sn55.40:4.3: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.40:4.4: so tehi ariyakantehi sīlehi santuṭṭho na uttariṃ vāyamati divā pavivekāya rattiṃ paṭisallānāya.
sn55.40:4.5: tassa evaṃ pamattassa viharato pāmujjaṃ na hoti.
sn55.40:4.12: evaṃ kho nandiya, ariyasāvako pamādavihārī hoti.
sn55.40:5.2: idha nandiya, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.40:5.3: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.40:5.4: so tena buddhe aveccappasādena asantuṭṭho uttariṃ vāyamati divā pavivekāya rattiṃ paṭisallānāya.
sn55.40:5.5: tassa evaṃ appamattassa viharato pāmujjaṃ jāyati.
sn55.40:6.3: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.40:6.4: so tehi ariyakantehi sīlehi asantuṭṭho uttariṃ vāyamati divā pavivekāya rattiṃ paṭisallānāya.
sn55.40:6.5: tassa evaṃ appamattassa viharato pāmujjaṃ jāyati.
sn55.40:6.12: evaṃ kho nandiya, ariyasāvako appamādavihārī hotīti.
